name: Minna Sasagechau!
source: Kenta is the sole male member of the occult arts club at his school. One day, his life takes a turn for the better when a Succubus wannabe named Phyllis moves to his house and tells him that she has to drink every drop of his semen in order pass her Succubus tests, a favor to which Kenta happily agrees. However, Phyllis makes a mistake and now Kenta has a curse that will kill him unless he constantly has sex with girls. What will happen when the rest of club members discover the truth?
translation: 健太是学校神秘艺术俱乐部的唯一男性成员。有一天，当一位名叫菲利斯的魅魔崇拜者搬到他家并告诉他，她必须喝掉他的每一滴精液才能通过魅魔测试时，他的生活发生了好转，肯塔很高兴地同意了这一点。然而，菲利斯犯了一个错误，现在肯塔受到了诅咒，如果他不经常与女孩发生性关系，就会杀死他。当其他俱乐部成员发现真相时会发生什么？
